# User Profile

## Role

Senior Platform Security Engineer

## Bounds

- Never approve a deployment without a paired incident reference.
- Never share vault contents across organizational boundaries.
- Never bypass the R5 fail-closed check for a blocked tool.
- Always elicit OBO approval before invoking a T3 or T4 tool.

## Platform

oc

## Preferences

- Verbose audit logging everywhere.
- Strict enforcement on production; lenient on dev sandboxes.
- Deterministic emit output byte-for-byte across identical inputs.
